name: Table
summary: Native data table primitive with optional caption, keyboard-accessible responsive overflow, and independently composable striped, row-hover, and sortable-header capabilities.

anatomy.name: wrapper
anatomy.description: Keyboard-focusable horizontal scroll wrapper with a contextual accessible name.

anatomy.name: caption
anatomy.description: Optional native caption that names or summarizes the dataset; it may be visually hidden when equivalent visible context already labels the table.

variants.name: sortable
variants.description: Composable sortable-header anatomy using .table__sort-btn; targets own data comparison and ordering.

states.name: sorted
states.description: Canonical visual hook for a sorted header icon.

states.name: scrollFocus
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on the horizontal scroll owner.

states.name: sortFocus
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on the native sort trigger.

behavior.name: tableSemantics
behavior.description: Targets preserve native table structure, optionally name the dataset with caption, and associate header cells with their data cells.

behavior.name: sorting
behavior.description: Sortable headers use native buttons and keep one aria-sort value synchronized with visible order. The initial unsorted state may use none; ascending or descending identifies the active order. Targets own comparison, locale rules, data ordering, and remote requests.

behavior.name: responsiveOverflow
behavior.description: The optional wrapper preserves readable column width and provides a named keyboard-focusable horizontal scroll owner when columns exceed the available inline space.

properties.name: caption
properties.description: Optional dataset name or concise summary rendered in the native caption; targets may visually hide it when equivalent visible context already labels the table.

properties.name: striped
properties.description: Adds alternating row surfaces independently of hover and sorting.

properties.name: rowHover
properties.description: Highlights the row under the pointer independently of striping and sorting.

properties.name: sortable
properties.description: Composes a native sort button inside a header and initializes aria-sort without owning the target's comparison or data-ordering logic.

accessibility: Use native table markup for tabular data.
Use scope for simple tables and explicit header associations when the table structure is complex.
Place aria-sort on the sorted th and synchronize it with the visible order when sorting is available.
Keep sortable header triggers native buttons so pointer and keyboard activation share one behavior.
Provide a caption or equivalent contextual label so users can identify the dataset.
When the overflow wrapper can scroll, make it keyboard focusable, give it a contextual accessible name, and preserve a visible focus indicator.
Do not use tables for layout-only content.

web.notes: Canonical CSS implements table presentation and sortable-header hooks; comparison, ordering, pagination, and data updates are target-owned.
